tasks.title: Create model 'lab-relate'
tasks.instructions:
Create a new Juju model named `lab-relate`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-relate
```

Verify that the active model is `lab-relate`:

```bash
juju switch
```

tasks.title: Deploy 'ingress-proxy' and 'backend-service'
tasks.instructions:
Deploy two applications using the `haproxy` charm from channel `latest/stable`:

```bash
juju deploy haproxy ingress-proxy --channel latest/stable
juju deploy haproxy backend-service --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that both applications appear in `juju status`:

```bash
juju status
```
hints: Deploy both applications with `juju deploy haproxy <alias> --channel latest/stable`.
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju deploy haproxy ingress-proxy --channel latest/stable
juju deploy haproxy backend-service --channel latest/stable
```

tasks.title: Integrate 'ingress-proxy' with 'backend-service'
tasks.instructions:
Integrate the reverseproxy endpoint of `ingress-proxy` with the website endpoint of `backend-service`:

```bash
juju integrate ingress-proxy:reverseproxy backend-service:website
```

Verify that the relation is listed:

```bash
juju relations
```
